rv.q: The bells, whistles and strangers in your group really do elevate the Live Experience into something more than a cynical tie-ie.
The Traitors: Live Experience is not just a cynical cash-in.
I can safely say I have never enjoyed an experience I have attended quite as much as I did this - it was everything I wanted from a Traitors live experience and more.
I absolutely loved every moment of The Traitors: Live Experience London.
It’s clever, tense, and so much fun – but be warned: the lies, backstabbing, and psychological tricks are all part of the game.
It did feel like we were filming an episode of the TV show, with contestants fully getting wrapped up in the concept and trying to throw one another under the bus.

cn.t: Critics praise The Traitors: Live Experience as thrilling and addictive, successfully translating the TV show's psychological tension and backstabbing gameplay into an immersive format that proves "massively fun" and "surprisingly exhilarating."
